# Changelog - Sindri v2

All notable changes to Sindri v2 (Bash/Docker) will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [2.5.2] - 2026-10-23

Security patch release from the `v2.5.x` maintenance branch. No feature changes since 2.5.1.

### :lock: Security

- deps(v2.5.x): refresh the `vf-management-api` extension lockfile within its existing ranges for npm advisories: fastify 5.12.7, find-my-way 9.10.0, fast-uri 3.1.9, ws 8.22.0, minimatch 9.0.9, brace-expansion 2.1.7, ajv 8.20.0, yaml 2.9.1, fast-copy 3.1.0. `npm audit --audit-level=high`: 7 high and 5 moderate down to 1 high (ignored, see below) and 2 moderate (#381)
- deps(v2.5.x): bump yq 4.52.2 → 4.54.1 and the GitHub CLI 2.86.0 → 2.102.0 in the image. Trivy (CRITICAL/HIGH, fixable): 86 findings down to 10 (#381)

### :wrench: Maintenance

- ci(v2.5.x): v2 CI now runs on `v2.5.x`, with the standard `Dependency Audit` job (`npm audit --audit-level=high` on every committed `package-lock.json` under `v2/`, fails closed on registry errors) required by `CI v2 Required Checks` (#381)
- ci(v2.5.x): pin `aquasecurity/trivy-action` by commit SHA (v0.36.0, was `@master`) with Trivy 0.76.0
- ci(v2.5.x): release v2 from `v2.5.x`: the changelog/VERSION bookkeeping job no longer targets `main`, and pushes to `v2.5.x` produce the `v2-ci-passed-<sha>` image that the release promotes
- chore(v2.5.x): `v2/cli/VERSION` 2.5.2

### Known issues

- GHSA-83w8-p2f5-377r (`@fastify/static` 7.x via `@fastify/swagger-ui` 3.x in `vf-management-api`) is listed in `v2/npm-audit-ignore`. The fix needs `@fastify/swagger-ui` 6 (a major), and the code isn't reachable as shipped: the extension's fastify-4 plugins stop the server at boot against fastify 5.
- The 10 remaining Trivy findings are Go 1.27.1 standard library and `x/net` CVEs compiled into the `gh` and `yq` binaries. No yq release carries the fix yet.

### Installation

```bash
# Pull Docker image
docker pull ghcr.io/pacphi/sindri:v2.5.2

# Or use specific tag
docker pull ghcr.io/pacphi/sindri:v2

# Run container
docker run -it -v sindri-home:/alt/home/developer ghcr.io/pacphi/sindri:v2.5.2
```

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pacphi/sindri/compare/v2.5.1...v2.5.2
